Name: Matthew
Summary: Matthew, also called Levi, was a tax collector despised as a collaborator until Jesus called him with two words: Follow Me. He hosted a feast for Jesus and wrote the first Gospel, presenting Jesus as King.
KeyStory: Matthew left his tax booth immediately at Jesus' call, rising and following Him without finishing the day's accounts.
LifeLesson: If Jesus could call a tax collector to write a Gospel, no one is too far gone or too compromised to be called. Follow Me can rewrite a life in a single step of obedience.
